Payment & Withdrawal Fee Notice

Payment processing fees are shared between buyer and seller across all transfer and card payments. Buyers pay a Service Charge at checkout (0.75% capped at ₦1,000 for NGN; 2.5% + $0.20 for USD), and the remaining gateway fee is deducted before settling into your wallet (Gross Sales − Gateway Fees = Net Available Balance).
